evidence_excerpts: It is likely that future research in the contemplative sciences will provide a developmental trajectory of different S-ART-specific subcomponents and individual differences across duration and frequency of practice.

It is also critical that the emerging field examine the adverse effects of long-term practice—effects that typically go unnoticed in clinical trials, but are more prevalent in longer retreats and in practitioners that may or may not have a predisposition toward developing psychopathology.
text: Future mindfulness research needs longitudinal measurement of S-ART subcomponents, dose effects, practice quality, and possible adverse effects.
